title: Fixed Curved Five Ribbon and Crosswise Palm Grip Blender

Opposing end mounts connect all five ribbons and seat into the grip. All visible numeric geometry newly authored; no imported model or chopped part. Three constant opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and horizontal bounds-centred origin at the lower ribbon soles. One original whole model zero scenes, not five ribbon assets. Empty static artistic tool only: blunt finite bands, no sharp cutting edge, food, blending, cutting performance, hand fit, flex, cleaning, strength, food-contact certification, manufacture or safety capability. No rigging animation or interaction.
